sentences.text:
Debika Ghatak & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 17
May, 2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
17.05.2023 Sl. No.17.
D/L. Mithun.
Ct.No.42.
Crr/4105/2022

Debika Ghatak & Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.

Mr. Shamsher Ansari, Adv.
Mr. Ayan Mondal, Adv.
...for the petitioners.
Opposite party No.2 had a subsisting marriage on the date of purported marriage between petitioner No.1 and opposite party No.2.
Therefore, so-called marriage between the opposite party No.2 and the petitioner No.1 is void ab initio.
The issue involved in the instant revision is as to whether in a void marriage, allegation of cruelty within the meaning of Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code attracts or not.
Other allegations under Sections 325/ 506 of the Indian Penal Code were ultimately added while committing offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
In view of such circumstances, the instant revision is admitted.
The petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with acknowledgment due and file affidavit of service within two weeks after vacation.
